name: Waikato River Authority contestable funding round
summary: Annual contestable round allocating around NZD 6 million to restoration and protection projects in the Waikato and Waipā river catchments. Applicants must consult river iwi and show co-funding.

status.quote: The Waikato River Authority 2026 funding round opened on Tuesday, 2nd June 2026 and closed on Monday, 27th July 2026 at 4pm.
